label: Lead time, session to live
means: Hours from a session's start to its change live, each step's typical time added up.
goal_source: goal from DORA's elite band (2024 Accelerate State of DevOps Report, p. 13, dora.dev/research/2024/dora-report), change lead time less than one day. Near is the high band's edge, one week. DORA times "from committed to version control to deployed in production" (dora.dev/guides/dora-metrics, read 2026-11-10); this starts at the session, a little earlier, and in CI at the PR opening
source: last N merged PRs timed end to end (N = params.last_prs, default 10): the median hours of session start to PR open (this Mac's transcripts, local runs only; in CI it is named in missing and the metric is could_not_check, the read steps kept in detail), PR open to all green, all green to merge and merge to live (gh api graphql: createdAt, the merged head's last check, mergedAt, and the first successful params.environment deployment created at or after the merge), summed, so the parts add up to the whole (quality/collectors/claude/lead-time.mjs)

params.comment: last_prs: how many of the latest merged PRs, timed end to end, take each step's median. environment: the GitHub deployment environment whose first success after a merge is the change going live; a repo that deploys with Wrangler has none, so merge to live is named in missing. Transcripts: the Claude tab's projects_dir and project_match (targets/claude.json).
